SOURCE OF TRUTH for the 25 points, transcribed from the site's tag

It is data, not configuration. Nothing here is baked into a Helm chart or
a container image: seed-tags.py pushes it into a running EmberBurn through
POST /api/tags/bulk, and EmberBurn persists it to its own data volume. To
change a tag, edit this file and re-run the seeder, or edit it live in the
EmberBurn web UI at :5000 — no chart edit, no release, no redeploy.
Derived points (TotalRealPower, Demand15Min) use the `computed` model:
their expression rides in the tag definition, so they are created and
persisted through the same API as everything else rather than living in
chart values. `dependencies` is a mapping because a UNS path is not a
Python identifier — Power/Switchboard_01/CurrentA is three divisions to
Naming is the UNS path: Area/Asset/Point. AnvilMQ's SparkplugB decoder
appends the Sparkplug metric name to its destination topic, so these names
